mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and, subsequently, higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with 2%+ GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, S&P 500 forward returns tend to decline over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS grows by 200,000+ in a month, indicating a strong labor market, S&P 500 returns tend to increase over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite strong labor market signals.

mechanism_narrative: A 1.5% monthly increase in INDPRO, signaling increased industrial production, tends to lead to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to expectations of higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO growth and SPX returns remains below 0.2 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) grows by 1%+ in a month, indicating strong consumer demand, and concurrently HOUST (housing starts) increases by 5%+, signaling a robust housing market, S&P 500 returns tend to rise over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with strong RSAFS and HOUST growth.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% decrease in CPIAUCSL (consumer price index) over two months, indicating easing inflation pressures, tends to lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate decreased likelihood of monetary tightening.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises by 0.5% in a single month, signaling potential labor market overheating, S&P 500 returns tend to decline over the next 5 trading days due to increased expectations of monetary policy intervention.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE increase.

mechanism_narrative: Always, GDPC1 growth rates are positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as GDP growth is a fundamental driver of equity market performance.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between GDPC1 growth and SPX returns remains below 0.2 over any 3-year rolling window.
